student_learning_goal: I can use a rule to predict a town outcome.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can use a rule to predict a town outcome.
header.character_watermark: Mayor Mira in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Rule: 5 buses per day. Predict for 1, 3, 5, 10 days.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Four prediction rows.

image_placeholders.description: Four prediction rows in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Each row: '___ days → ___ buses'. Pre-filled days: 1, 3, 5, 10. Header 'Bus Predictions (rule: 5 buses/day):'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P1_BUS: keywords (predictions) name what the rows ask for.

parts.student_instructions: Use 4 different town rules. Predict outcomes for 1 week (5 days).
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Four town-rule rows.

image_placeholders.description: Four town-rule rows in B&W line-art, ~7in x 3in. Each row: rule on top + prediction slot below. Pre-filled rules: '3 books per child x 24 kids = ___ books per day. Predict 5 days.', '60 sandwiches per lunch. Predict 5 days.', '15-min recess x 4 per week = ___', '10 library visitors per hour x 6 hours = ___'. Header 'Town Rules (1 week):'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P2_TOWN: keywords (town, rules) name what the rows ask for.

parts.answer_key: 72 books per day x 5 = 360 books. 60 x 5 = 300 sandwiches. 15 x 4 = 60 minutes. 10 x 6 = 60 visitors.

parts.student_instructions: Pick your own town rule. Predict for 5 days.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. A blank rule and prediction box.

image_placeholders.description: A blank rule and prediction box in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. 'My rule: ___'. 'For 5 days, my prediction is: ___'. Drawing area on the right. Header 'My Town Rule:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P3_MY: keywords (my, rule) name what the box asks for.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, invent a 2-rule prediction (e.g., morning + afternoon buses).
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 worksheet practices C4 step 3 prediction. Watch for the time-doesn't-multiply trap.
